# System Overview

The laboratory automation system contains:

- A glovebox
- A custom reagent cabinet
- A robotic arm
- Reaction modules
- Analytical instruments

# Communication Interfaces

|------------------------|-----------|-----------------|
| Balance                | RS-232    | Vendor protocol |
| Temperature controller | RS-485    | Modbus RTU      |
| Motion controller      | Ethernet  | TCP/IP          |
| AGV                    | Ethernet  | REST API        |
